header: Sex-wise break-up of arrested persons indicated in Table-22 reveals that involvement of females is only 3.1 per cent. However it is strange to note that the highest percentage (4.2) of female criminals is for a crime which is against their own sex i.e. 'Kidnapping And Abduction Of Women And Girls'.

State-wise details on number of persons arrested during 1989 and 1990 alongwith their percentage variation is presented in Table-23. The table also gives percentage contribution of each State UT to all-India total during 1990. It is seen that the highest share is of Uttar Pradesh (13.4%) followed by Madhya Pradesh (11.2%) Bihar (10.8%)
